blur_detection.description: The invoice image is exceptionally sharp with clear text definition and high legibility throughout.
blur_detection.recommendation: No action required as the text clarity is excellent for OCR processing.

contrast_assessment.description: The contrast between black text and white background is excellent, providing optimal readability across the entire document.
contrast_assessment.recommendation: Maintain this level of contrast in future document captures.

glare_identification.description: No glare or reflective bright spots are present on the invoice surface.
glare_identification.recommendation: Continue using even, non-direct lighting when capturing document images.

water_stains.description: No water stains, discoloration, or water damage visible on the invoice.
water_stains.recommendation: Continue keeping documents in dry storage conditions.

tears_or_folds.description: The invoice appears completely flat with no visible folds, creases, or tears.
tears_or_folds.recommendation: Maintain current document handling practices to avoid physical damage.

cut_off_detection.description: The entire invoice is visible within the frame with adequate margins on all sides.
cut_off_detection.recommendation: Continue capturing full-frame images of documents with sufficient border space.

missing_sections.description: All standard invoice sections are present including header, recipient information, line items, and payment details.
missing_sections.recommendation: Current capture method effectively includes all relevant invoice components.

obstructions.description: No shadows, fingers, or objects obstruct any portion of the invoice content.
obstructions.recommendation: Maintain current unobstructed document imaging technique.
